description: Inspect current source directory, newly collected files, weekly snapshots, and locate permitted research documents.

tools.description: List canonical source organizations and current file counts.

List public files by system first_seen. Filter by source organization if named. Set window_days to 7 when the question asks what the site first collected in the past seven days; omit it for the latest files.
Search current public file titles, filenames, URL and catalog text; metadata does not prove body findings.
Read latest complete published weekly snapshot and its first-seen members; no snapshot is explicit.
Locate a permitted KB report by title, organization, alias or summary; can be followed by document_research body read.
Read distinct publication, system first-seen and KB-added dates for a current permitted report; revision history unavailable.
